remarks: Exceptional newly built luxury home nestled within the coveted gated community of The Oaks in Portola Hills. This stunning home, built in 2022 boasts 4208 square feet of living space. With five bedrooms, a loft, and five and a half baths, this residence offers ample accommodation for both family and guests. The interior is adorned with high-end finishes and exquisite details at every turn. Downstairs bedroom has a kitchenette, bath, and a private entry. Every room has its own bath. The gourmet kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, featuring quartz countertops, top-of-the-line appliances, and a massive center island ideal for hosting gatherings and entertaining in style.
